title: Mark Zuckerberg to Stay in California Under New Agreement
excerpt: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has agreed to remain in California despite a proposed billionaires' tax ballot measure, supported by a new stock incentive.
body_html:
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has committed to staying in California despite a proposed billionaires' tax ballot measure. The decision follows concerns from Meta's board that his potential departure could negatively impact the company's artificial intelligence goals.

To address these concerns, a new stock agreement has been established to provide Zuckerberg with financial incentives to remain in the state. The agreement ensures that leadership continuity is maintained as the company continues its focus on AI development.
